lines.zh: 水里我一摆尾就是十几格。
lines.en: In water one flick of my tail carries me ten blocks.

lines.zh: 上岸之后，我只能一寸寸爬。
lines.en: Ashore, I crawl an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 我的腿不习惯扛这具身体。
lines.en: My legs are not used to carrying this body.

lines.zh: 我沿着河床走，水替我抬着。
lines.en: I travel the riverbed; the water lifts me.

lines.zh: 泥滩上留下一条长长的痕。
lines.en: A long smear trails behind me on the mudflat.

lines.zh: 爬过礁石时，鳞片刮得响。
lines.en: My scales rasp as I drag over the reef.

lines.zh: 我上岸是为了追人，不是为了走。
lines.en: I come ashore to hunt, not to walk.

lines.zh: 水里我从不迷路，岸上常走错。
lines.en: I never lose my way in water; on land I often do.

lines.zh: 每爬一步，我都要歇半口气。
lines.en: Every crawl-step costs me half a breath.

lines.zh: 潮水退去，我就得自己挪。
lines.en: When the tide goes out, I must haul myself.

lines.zh: 我的鳍在陆上只能当拐杖。
lines.en: On land my fins serve only as crutches.

lines.zh: 别在浅滩站着，那里我最灵活。
lines.en: Do not stand in the shallows; that is where I am nimble.

lines.zh: 我泡在深水里，只露一对眼睛。
lines.en: I soak in deep water with only my eyes showing.

lines.zh: 胆汁在喉囊里翻，咕噜作响。
lines.en: Bile churns in my throat sac, gurgling.

lines.zh: 我等船经过，等得很耐心。
lines.en: I wait for a boat, and I wait patiently.

lines.zh: 水面上的光，让我想起沉船的灯。
lines.en: The light on the water recalls a sunken ship's lamp.

lines.zh: 我数着潮汐，一次也没错。
lines.en: I count the tides and never miss one.

lines.zh: 水草缠住我的角，我懒得理。
lines.en: Weeds snag my horns; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，鱼就来啄我的甲。
lines.en: I stay still, and fish peck at my shell.

lines.zh: 这具身体不喘，可我还是憋气。
lines.en: This body need not breathe, yet I still hold my breath.

lines.zh: 远处有桨声，我听见了。
lines.en: Oars sound in the distance. I hear them.

lines.zh: 水底的泥很软，正好垫着。
lines.en: The silt below is soft, a fine cushion.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，水从角上流下来。
lines.en: I raise my head and water runs off my horns.

lines.zh: 你在干地上，我在水皮底下瞧你。
lines.en: You keep to dry ground; I watch from under the surface.

lines.zh: 你的船，比你的脸更吸引我。
lines.en: Your boat interests me more than your face.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，喉囊鼓了一下。
lines.en: As I look at you, my throat sac swells.

lines.zh: 你身上没有水腥味，是干的人。
lines.en: You carry no water-smell. You are a dry one.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里打招呼。
lines.en: Do not put your hand in the water to wave.

lines.zh: 我认得灾厄的旗子，也认得你。
lines.en: I know illager banners, and I know you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲厚，可缝隙里有水。
lines.en: Your armor is thick, but water finds its seams.

lines.zh: 我数你船上几个人。
lines.en: I am counting how many are in your boat.

lines.zh: 你往后退，水会把你送回来。
lines.en: Step back, and the water will bring you to me.

lines.zh: 砍在我甲上，声音像敲船板。
lines.en: The blade rings on my shell like a struck hull.

lines.zh: 三百五十点血，砍到天亮也不够。
lines.en: Three hundred fifty points; you could cut till dawn.

lines.zh: 这一刀划开了我的鳃。
lines.en: That cut opened one of my gills.

lines.zh: 我退了，水把我托回来。
lines.en: I fell back, and the water bore me up again.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出的东西，比水黏。
lines.en: What seeps from the wound is thicker than water.

lines.zh: 你的剑卡在我甲缝里了。
lines.en: Your sword is stuck in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 我疼的时候，胆汁更酸。
lines.en: When I hurt, my bile turns more sour.

lines.zh: 别砍角，角断了长不回来。
lines.en: Not the horns; a broken horn never grows back.

lines.zh: 疼起来，我又听见船板断裂的声音。
lines.en: The pain brings back the sound of a hull breaking.

lines.zh: 我流血，水就浑了一片。
lines.en: I bleed, and a patch of water clouds.

lines.zh: 把船推过来，我就先不吃人。
lines.en: Push the boat over, and I will hold off on eating.

lines.zh: 铁锚的味道，像血。
lines.en: An iron anchor tastes like blood.

lines.zh: 你船上的木头，我咬得动。
lines.en: I can bite through the wood of your boat.

lines.zh: 扔条鱼下来，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Toss me a fish and I will overlook you.

lines.zh: 我喜欢亮的东西，尤其是铜铃。
lines.en: I like shiny things, especially brass bells.

lines.zh: 别拿面包哄我，我要的是船。
lines.en: Do not coax me with bread; it is the boat I want.

lines.zh: 你腰上那串钥匙，响得真好听。
lines.en: That ring of keys at your belt chimes sweetly.

lines.zh: 把桨留下，人可以走。
lines.en: Leave the oars; you may go.

lines.zh: 沉船里的货，我全都要。
lines.en: The cargo in that wreck is all mine.

lines.zh: 落水的箱子，漂到我这儿就算我的。
lines.en: A crate that floats to me is mine.

lines.zh: 我撞船，比撞人顺手。
lines.en: Ramming boats comes more naturally than ramming people.

lines.zh: 你被我顶得往后退了三步。
lines.en: My shove sends you back three steps.

lines.zh: 我的甲比你的盾硬。
lines.en: My shell is harder than your shield.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的护腿凹了。
lines.en: That impact dented your leggings.

lines.zh: 水下的力，比你想的大。
lines.en: The force underwater is greater than you think.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你身边，留下一层黏液。
lines.en: I brush past and leave a layer of slime.

lines.zh: 你撞得自己跌进浅水，我只晃了晃。
lines.en: You knock yourself into the shallows; I merely sway.

lines.zh: 我退了半格，水花溅了你一脸。
lines.en: I gave half a block, and the splash hit your face.

lines.zh: 别在窄处挡我，我停不住。
lines.en: Do not block me in a narrow place; I cannot stop.

lines.zh: 这一下不是打架，是路过。
lines.en: That was not a fight. I was passing through.

lines.zh: 我们在深水里绕圈，绕到天亮。
lines.en: We circle in deep water until dawn.

lines.zh: 她的角比我的长一截。
lines.en: Her horns are a hand longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们用胆汁的味道找彼此。
lines.en: We find each other by the smell of bile.

lines.zh: 两副甲靠在一起，像两条沉船。
lines.en: Two shells lie together like two wrecks.

lines.zh: 我们不合群，成了对也不合。
lines.en: We are not sociable, not even as a pair.

lines.zh: 她吐我一身胆汁，算是答应。
lines.en: She spat bile on me. That was her yes.

lines.zh: 潮水把我们推到同一处礁。
lines.en: The tide pushed us onto the same reef.

lines.zh: 我们的卵沉在泥里，没人找得到。
lines.en: Our eggs sink in the silt where none can find them.

lines.zh: 并排游的时候，水声像一条。
lines.en: Swimming side by side, we sound like one.

lines.zh: 她走了，水面上什么都没留。
lines.en: She left, and the surface kept nothing.

lines.zh: 我不用手，我用嘴叼。
lines.en: I do not use hands; I carry things in my teeth.

lines.zh: 沉底的箱子，我拖得动。
lines.en: I can drag a sunken chest.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的剑，先归我。
lines.en: A sword dropped in the water is mine first.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，只捡会沉的。
lines.en: I only pick up things that sink.

lines.zh: 那枚金币，我含在腮里。
lines.en: That gold coin rests in my cheek pouch.

lines.zh: 我把战利品堆在沉船里。
lines.en: I stack my takings inside the wreck.

lines.zh: 船桨我咬断过很多根。
lines.en: I have bitten through many oars.

lines.zh: 想拿回你的东西？潜下来试试。
lines.en: Want your things back? Dive and try.

lines.zh: 我拖着一整只木桶游了很远。
lines.en: I swam far dragging a whole barrel.

lines.zh: 水底那堆骨头，都是我攒的。
lines.en: That pile of bones below is my collection.

lines.zh: 十七格，正好在我的射程里。
lines.en: Seventeen blocks. Right inside my range.

lines.zh: 你比我高五格，我照样够得着。
lines.en: You stand five blocks up; I can still reach.

lines.zh: 我听见桨，就知道有人来了。
lines.en: I hear an oar and know someone has come.

lines.zh: 船一停，你就成了目标。
lines.en: The boat stops, and you become the target.

lines.zh: 我先看你的船，再看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at your boat first, then your face.

lines.zh: 水里的动静，我从不漏掉。
lines.en: No stir in the water escapes me.

lines.zh: 你一靠近岸线，喉囊就满了。
lines.en: As you near the shoreline, my throat sac fills.

lines.zh: 我选目标，先选最不会游的。
lines.en: I pick the one who swims worst.

lines.zh: 高处那个，我也能吐到。
lines.en: Even the one up high, I can spit at.

lines.zh: 你在桥上走，我在桥下等。
lines.en: You walk the bridge; I wait beneath it.

lines.zh: 你的火把照亮水面，也照亮你。
lines.en: Your torch lights the water, and lights you.

lines.zh: 我认准了，就不会换。
lines.en: Once I have chosen, I do not switch.

lines.zh: 十七格外的那个，先放着。
lines.en: The one past seventeen blocks can wait.

lines.zh: 只要你还在水边，我就有活干。
lines.en: As long as you stay by the water, I have work.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，嘴里的胆汁已经发酸。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, and the bile in my throat sours.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，只留一道水纹。
lines.en: I sink and leave only a ripple.

lines.zh: 你划船，我在船底跟着。
lines.en: You row; I follow beneath the hull.

lines.zh: 我绕到下游，等你自己漂过来。
lines.en: I circle downstream and wait for you to drift.

lines.zh: 你往左看，我从右边换气。
lines.en: You look left; I surface on the right.

lines.zh: 我的胆汁在水下也能飞。
lines.en: My bile flies even underwater.

lines.zh: 你数着浪，我数你划了几下。
lines.en: You count waves; I count your strokes.

lines.zh: 船板裂的声音，我最爱听。
lines.en: The sound of a hull splitting is my favorite.

lines.zh: 我不急，水会把你送到岸边。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the water will bring you ashore.

lines.zh: 你跑上坡，我在坡下水潭等。
lines.en: Run uphill; I will wait in the pool below.

lines.zh: 我的角破开水面，像一把刀。
lines.en: My horns break the surface like a blade.

lines.zh: 你回头看船，它已经少了一块。
lines.en: Look back at your boat; a piece is gone.

lines.zh: 我贴着河岸的泥走，声音很小。
lines.en: I creep along the muddy bank almost silently.

lines.zh: 你在浅水里跑不快。
lines.en: You cannot run fast in the shallows.

lines.zh: 这片水域，我闭眼都能走。
lines.en: I know these waters well enough to cross blind.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底走，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I skim the bottom, showing only one eye.

lines.zh: 你在岸上跑，我在水里等你。
lines.en: Run on the shore. I'll wait in the water.

lines.zh: 我把喉咙鼓起来，你听见了吗。
lines.en: I swell my throat. Can you hear it?

lines.zh: 上游下游，都是我的地界。
lines.en: Upstream, downstream. It's all my range.

lines.zh: 二十五点力气，一次给你。
lines.en: Twenty-five points of force, all at once.

lines.zh: 我的爪子撕开你的胸甲。
lines.en: My claws tear your chestplate open.

lines.zh: 角顶上来，你整个人翻了。
lines.en: My horns catch you and you go over.

lines.zh: 水里打人，我占尽了便宜。
lines.en: Fighting in water, I hold every advantage.

lines.zh: 这一下，够你沉底。
lines.en: This blow is enough to send you down.

lines.zh: 我咬住船舷，连着木头一起扯。
lines.en: I bite the gunwale and tear wood with it.

lines.zh: 别以为爬上石头就安全。
lines.en: Do not think the rocks make you safe.

lines.zh: 我的力气都从水里来。
lines.en: All my strength comes from the water.

lines.zh: 你护甲的缝，正好给我下爪。
lines.en: The seam in your armor is where my claw goes.

lines.zh: 挨完，你会尝到胆汁的味道。
lines.en: After this, you will taste bile.

lines.zh: 我拍一下水面，浪就把你推倒。
lines.en: One slap of the water knocks you off your feet.

lines.zh: 我撕开的是船，不是你，先别谢。
lines.en: I tore the boat, not you. Do not thank me yet.

lines.zh: 这一爪带着河底的泥。
lines.en: This claw comes with riverbed mud on it.

lines.zh: 我拖着你的腿，往深处去。
lines.en: I drag your leg toward the deep.

lines.zh: 我把你按进水里，让你看着。
lines.en: I hold you under and make you watch.

lines.zh: 这一口咬的是你的护颈。
lines.en: This bite lands on your gorget.

lines.zh: 我从河口浮上来，先吐了口胆汁。
lines.en: I surfaced at the river mouth, spitting bile first.

lines.zh: 沉船里那具身体，重新睁开了眼。
lines.en: The body in the wreck opened its eyes again.

lines.zh: 灾厄的号角在水下也响。
lines.en: The illager horn sounds even underwater.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里长齐了甲。
lines.en: I grew my shell full in a crevice of the reef.

lines.zh: 第一次下水，我就没再想上岸。
lines.en: The first time I entered water, I stopped wanting land.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推到岸边，我又爬回去。
lines.en: The tide pushed me ashore; I crawled back in.

lines.zh: 我的角先破水，然后是眼睛。
lines.en: My horns broke the surface first, then my eyes.

lines.zh: 这具身体在水里死了三回。
lines.en: This body has died three times in water.

lines.zh: 我出生那天，河上正好有船翻。
lines.en: The day I was born, a boat capsized upstream.

lines.zh: 岸上的空气太干，我不习惯。
lines.en: The air ashore is too dry for me.

lines.zh: 我在泥里埋了七天，才有力气游。
lines.en: I lay seven days in the mud before I could swim.

lines.zh: 水草给我让开一条路。
lines.en: The weeds parted to let me through.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧不久，我也是。
lines.en: Fire does not last on water, nor do I.

lines.zh: 我从礁上摔下来，甲裂了一角。
lines.en: I fell from the reef and cracked a corner of shell.

lines.zh: 我在水里怎么会淹？可这具身体会。
lines.en: How does a water thing drown? This body manages.

lines.zh: 炸开的浪，把我抛上了岸。
lines.en: The blast threw me up onto the shore.

lines.zh: 箭射进甲缝，卡得很深。
lines.en: An arrow lodged deep in my shell's seam.

lines.zh: 药水在我甲上滑走了。
lines.en: The potion slid off my shell.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，我啃自己的鳍。
lines.en: When starving, I gnaw my own fins.

lines.zh: 雷落进水里，整条河都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water, and the river lit up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我沉不下去。
lines.en: There is no water in the void; I cannot sink.
